features.name: Spell Combat
features.summary: Cast a Magus spell and make a full attack with a light or one-handed melee weapon as a full-round action, taking a -2 penalty on attacks.

features.name: Arcane Pool
features.summary: Spend points to enhance a held weapon for 1 minute per Magus level.
features.uses: half Magus level + Intelligence modifier points per day

features.name: Cantrips and Spellbook
features.summary: Prepare arcane spells from a spellbook and cast prepared cantrips without expending them.

features.name: Spellstrike
features.summary: Deliver a touch spell through a weapon attack using the weapon's critical range.

features.name: Magus Arcana

features.name: Spell Recall
